Row2 exact title「保管する」helper「記録を残して一覧から移します。」; original archive box with separate horizontal lid and centered short white slot, slate on neutral small circle.
Row3 exact title「習慣を削除」helper「習慣と関連する記録を削除します。」; original trash-can outline with top handle/lid and3 vertical interior strokes. No forced green action or random icon colors. Pure white canvas/cards; subtle borders and soft depth; no broad mint, heavy gloss/glow, screen frame or watermark. Raster candidate.
